meta.name: perf-theory-tester
meta.description: Use when running controlled perf experiments to validate hypotheses.

copy.tagline: 运行性能实验验证假设
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要通过控制实验验证性能假设
copy.tagline_en: Run controlled performance experiments to validate hypotheses
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to validate performance hypotheses through controlled experiments

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: Claude 会按照严格的实验流程测试性能假设：先确认基线干净，然后只应用一个变更，运行至少两次验证，最后回退基线。输出包含假设ID、变更摘要、指标差异和结论（接受/拒绝/不确定）。
howto.when: 当你需要验证某个性能优化假设，并希望进行受控实验时触发。例如，在基准测试前或代码优化后。

say.text: 测试将循环展开从2改为4对性能的影响。
say.note: Claude会执行单变更实验并输出结果。

say.text: 验证缓存大小调整是否减少延迟。
say.note: Claude会运行两次验证并记录证据。

howto.what_en: Claude runs controlled perf experiments: confirms clean baseline, applies one change, runs 2+ validation passes, reverts baseline. Outputs hypothesis ID, change summary, delta metrics, and verdict (accept/reject/inconclusive).
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to validate a performance hypothesis with controlled experiments, e.g., before benchmarking or after code changes.

say_en.text: Test the effect of unrolling loop from 2 to 4 on performance.
say_en.note: Claude runs a single-change experiment and outputs results.

say_en.text: Verify if cache size adjustment reduces latency.
say_en.note: Claude runs two validation passes and records evidence.
